From 1e21270685ae4c14361dd501da62cdc4be867d4e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Keith Busch <kbusch@kernel.org>
Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2022 08:21:07 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: fix crc64 testmgr digest byte order

The result is set in little endian, so the expected digest needs to
be consistent for big endian machines.

Fixes: f3813f4b287e ("crypto: add rocksoft 64b crc guard tag framework")
Reported-by: Vasily Gorbik <gor@linux.ibm.com>
Reported-by: Corentin Labbe <clabbe.montjoie@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Keith Busch <kbusch@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220322142107.4581-1-kbusch@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

diff --git a/crypto/testmgr.h b/crypto/testmgr.h
index f1a22794c404..59919a636508 100644
--- a/crypto/testmgr.h
+++ b/crypto/testmgr.h
@@ -3686,11 +3686,11 @@ static const struct hash_testvec crc64_rocksoft_tv_template[] = {
 	{
 		.plaintext	= zeroes,
 		.psize		= 4096,
-		.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0x6482d367eb22b64eull },
+		.digest         = "\x4e\xb6\x22\xeb\x67\xd3\x82\x64",
 	}, {
 		.plaintext	= ones,
 		.psize		= 4096,
-		.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0xc0ddba7302eca3acull },
+		.digest         = "\xac\xa3\xec\x02\x73\xba\xdd\xc0",
 	}
 };
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `crypto/testmgr.h`**
   - The expected digest values for the CRC64 test vectors have been changed from a format using a `u64` array to a string literal format that represents the same values in little-endian byte order.
   - Specifically, the following changes were made:
     - The digest for the `zeroes` plaintext was changed from `(u8 *)(u64[]){ 0x6482d367eb22b64eull }` to `"\x4e\xb6\x22\xeb\x67\xd3\x82\x64"`.
     - The digest for the `ones` plaintext was changed from `(u8 *)(u64[]){ 0xc0ddba7302eca3acull }` to `"\xac\xa3\xec\x02\x73\xba\xdd\xc0"`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modifications in `crypto/testmgr.h` are directly related to ensuring that the expected digest values are consistent with the little-endian format used by the CRC64 implementation. This change addresses a bug that was reported regarding the byte order of the digest values, particularly for big-endian machines. The patch corrects the expected outputs in the test vectors to match the actual output produced by the CRC64 algorithm, thereby fixing the inconsistency that could lead to test failures on different architectures.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0x6482d367eb22b64eull },
.digest		= (u8 *)(u64[]){ 0xc0ddba7302eca3acull },
```
Reason:
The implementation produced CRC64 digest values in little-endian format, but the expected test vectors were not updated to match this format, leading to inconsistencies when the tests were run on big-endian machines.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
.digest         = "\x4e\xb6\x22\xeb\x67\xd3\x82\x64",
.digest         = "\xac\xa3\xec\x02\x73\xba\xdd\xc0",
```
Reason:
These changes update the expected digest values to be in little-endian format, ensuring consistency with the implementation and allowing the tests to pass correctly on big-endian machines.
